title: Passive Error Resilience Through Ultrametric Geometry: A Proposal for p-Adic Quantum Metrology
description: This paper proposes an ultrametric sensing framework that exploits hierarchical noise correlations to achieve sub-shot-noise precision without active quantum error correction, demonstrated on a room-temperature photonic platform with ~10 entangled photons. The framework identifies p-adic quantum error correction codes and ultrametric passive error resilience as novel research directions with zero external prior art.
